description.zh: 查端口被谁占用：port 8080 列出监听/连接该端口的进程，Enter 结束，Ctrl+Enter 连子进程；port java 反查某进程占的所有端口；留空列出全部监听端口
description.en: Find what occupies a port: port 8080 lists processes on it, Enter kills, Ctrl+Enter kills the tree; port java lists every port a process holds; empty lists all listening ports

hint.zh: 端口如 8080 或 :8080，也可输进程名如 java；留空列出全部监听
hint.en: a port like 8080 or :8080, or a process name like java; empty lists all listeners

ai.description: Show which processes occupy a TCP/UDP port (v4 and v6), with PID, process name, path and socket state, or list all listening ports when the query is empty. A non-numeric query matches process names and lists every port that process holds. Actions kill the process or its tree, copy the PID, path, netstat-style row or parent chain, reveal the executable, and kill with UAC for system-owned listeners. Destructive only on explicit action.

hint.zh: PID 4 等看不到进程信息的监听
hint.en: PID 4 and other listeners without visible process info
